intro: Ergonest Wardrobe is designed to maximise space without compromising on style. Combining intelligent storage planning with a streamlined sliding design, it creates a clutter-free bedroom experience.

features.title: Space-saving sliding doors for seamless accessibility
features.text: The smooth-gliding sliding shutters provide effortless access to the wardrobe's contents while eliminating the need for door swing clearance. This makes Ergonest an excellent choice for compact and efficiently planned bedrooms.

features.title: Dedicated locking system for enhanced privacy
features.text: Each sliding shutter is equipped with an independent lock, allowing different storage sections to be secured individually. This thoughtful feature offers greater convenience and peace of mind, especially in shared living spaces.

features.title: Dual hanging sections for efficient garment organisation
features.text: Two dedicated hanging zones help organise formal wear, everyday clothing, and longer garments separately, keeping your wardrobe well-structured and garments neatly maintained.

features.title: Lockable drawers for valuables and accessories
features.text: Two generously sized lockable drawers provide a secure place for important documents, jewellery, accessories, and other personal belongings, ensuring they remain organised and protected.

features.title: Versatile shelving for customised storage
features.text: Multiple spacious shelves accommodate folded garments, handbags, footwear, and storage boxes with ease. The flexible layout allows you to organise belongings according to your daily routine and storage needs.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
